{{Top}}
The '''PG-7u short-range primary threat analysis grid''' was a type of [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] analysis unit that was manufactured by [[Fabritech/Legends|Fabritech]], and could be found aboard [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptor]], where it was integrated into the [[ANs-7e sensor unit]].
